scenario: You back into a parked car
outcome: Your insurance pays for their repair (burgerlijke aansprakelijkheid).

scenario: You skid on ice and hit a lamppost
outcome: The omnium pays to repair your own car, even though it was your fault (materiële schade).

scenario: Hail dents the roof
outcome: Paid: hail, storm, fire and broken glass are covered.

scenario: Your car is stolen
outcome: Paid, within the theft conditions.

scenario: The gearbox breaks
outcome: Not paid: breakdowns and wear are not insured.

scenario: You crash after drinking
outcome: The insurer may claim the cost back from you.

scenario: Your laptop is stolen from the car
outcome: Not paid by the car policy.

scenario: You are hurt in your own crash
outcome: Not part of this policy, and neither are legal costs.

scenario: A fire starts in the kitchen
outcome: The damage to the building is paid (brandverzekering).

scenario: A storm takes tiles off the roof
outcome: Paid: storm, hail and snow damage.

scenario: A pipe bursts and floods the ground floor
outcome: Paid: water damage.

scenario: Lightning hits the house
outcome: Paid.

scenario: Burglars take your laptop
outcome: Only if you chose theft cover when you signed.

scenario: Damp slowly ruins a wall
outcome: Not paid: slow damage from age or damp.

scenario: The garden shed or pool is damaged
outcome: Often covered separately, so check.

scenario: You break a leg and stay three nights
outcome: The costs your mutuality does not pay.

scenario: You have planned surgery
outcome: The fees and treatment during the stay.

scenario: You choose a single room
outcome: The room supplement.

scenario: You need check-ups after the stay
outcome: Consultations and medication before and after.

scenario: A condition you already had
outcome: May be excluded or have a waiting period.

scenario: Cosmetic surgery
outcome: Unless it is medically needed.

scenario: Glasses or a visit to the dentist
outcome: Not part of hospitalisation cover.

scenario: A borrower dies
outcome: The rest of the loan is repaid (schuldsaldo).

scenario: Your partner stays in the house
outcome: They are not left with the debt.

scenario: You fall ill and cannot work
outcome: No payments are covered.

scenario: You lose your job
outcome: No payments are covered.

scenario: You are already behind on payments
outcome: Arrears are not covered.

scenario: You pay for the holiday with the card and get ill abroad
outcome: Medical costs, within the limits.

scenario: Your bag is lost on the flight
outcome: Luggage, within the limits.

scenario: You have to cancel a trip you paid with the card
outcome: Cancellation, within the limits.

scenario: A laptop you bought with the card is stolen next week
outcome: Purchase protection.

scenario: You paid for the trip another way
outcome: The card conditions do not apply.

scenario: A six-month exchange semester
outcome: Long stays are usually limited in length. Check the maximum.

scenario: Your child is not named on the cover
outcome: Only the people listed are insured.
